flows.title: Add a file to a repository through the web interface
steps: Open the repository and select the Files tab.
Navigate to the directory the file belongs in, then click Add file.
Choose to create a new file, which opens the editor screen.
Choose a name for the file and add its content.
Optional: instead of committing straight to the repository's main branch, select Open as a pull request to create a Pull Request.
Save the file with a message that summarises the changes.
